flows.name: Complete Stock Royale Match Lifecycle
flows.description: User queues into Ranked Match -> joins 30-60 player lobby -> selects market sector drop zone -> loots available tickers -> rotates as storm collapses -> wins 30-second trading duel -> survives to final circle -> claims #1 Victory Royale and receives MMR gain
flows.terminal_step: Victory Screen with MMR promotion and match summary

flows.name: Contested Drop / Sector Trading Duel
flows.description: Two players contest the same ticker or sector -> 30-second micro-trading duel countdown locks players in -> high-frequency price action trades executed -> winner takes both profits and retains ticker loot
flows.terminal_step: Duel outcome popup: loot stolen, opponent defeated or forced retreat

flows.name: Third-Party Battle Escalation
flows.description: Player spots an active duel on tactical radar in adjacent sector -> engages 'Third-Party' action -> joins live duel arena as third trader -> competes for the pot and liquidation credit
flows.terminal_step: Multi-way duel resolution and kill feed announcement

flows.name: Sector Collapse & Storm Tick Damage
flows.description: Outer market sectors trigger closing warning -> sectors turn to Storm/Liquidity Drain zone -> players in storm suffer $/sec tick damage to portfolio pot -> forced rotation to inner safe sector
flows.terminal_step: Safe zone reentry or liquidation due to pot exhaustion

flows.name: Ranked Season MMR & Golden Trader Tiering
flows.description: User views competitive rank dashboard -> tracks MMR progress across Bronze through Golden Trader tiers -> reviews match history, kills/liquidations, and seasonal leaderboard standings
flows.terminal_step: Ranked leaderboard rendered with user tier badge and division

flows.name: Quick Match Queue with Automated AI Bot Fill
flows.description: Player clicks Quick Play -> lobby spawns and fills remaining slots (up to 30-60) with simulated trading bots of varied risk styles -> countdown initiates match launch
flows.terminal_step: Match transitions from LOBBY to DROP_SELECTION with 30-60 participants

flows.name: Post-Elimination Spectator Mode & Kill Feed
flows.description: Eliminated trader transitions to spectator HUD -> monitors surviving sector battles, active duels, and live kill feed ticker until match ends
flows.terminal_step: Spectator view shows match conclusion and return to lobby button

flows.name: Authentication, Registration & Quick Guest Entry
flows.description: User navigates to /login -> authenticates via credentials or instant guest session -> session token is stored and validated -> redirected to dashboard or previous destination with active wallet
flows.terminal_step: Redirect to /dashboard with active authenticated user session

flows.name: Marketing Landing Page Discovery & Conversion Funnel
flows.description: Visitor navigates to / -> views Stock Royale hero with live status badges -> explores 4 gameplay pillars -> interacts with live 30s duel demo widget -> reviews Golden Trader leaderboard preview & FAQ -> clicks CTA ('Deploy to Stock Royale' or 'Sign In / Register') -> transitions to /dashboard/royale or /login

flows.name: Adaptive Dual-Theme Switching & Sticky Navigation Bar
flows.description: User clicks ThemeSwitch in sticky glassmorphic navbar -> toggles between light and dark modes -> all surfaces (navbar, hero, login card, gameplay pillars, duel simulator, leaderboard, FAQ, footer) smoothly transition color tokens with WCAG AAA contrast maintained
flows.terminal_step: Full DOM surface re-renders with active theme tokens and zero legibility regression
